```{r helper_functions, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

show_error_and_stop <- function(message_text) {
  tcltk::tkmessageBox(
    title = "Input error",
    message = message_text,
    icon = "error",
    type = "ok"
  )

  stop(message_text, call. = FALSE)
}

normalize_tk_path <- function(path_choice) {
  if (length(path_choice) == 0 || all(is.na(path_choice))) {
    return("")
  }

  path_choice |>
    as.character() |>
    paste(collapse = " ") |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("^\\{|\\}$", "")
}

choose_one_file <- function(caption) {
  chosen_path <- tcltk::tk_choose.files(
    caption = caption,
    multi = FALSE
  ) |>
    normalize_tk_path()

  if (identical(chosen_path, "")) {
    show_error_and_stop("No file was selected.")
  }

  chosen_path
}

choose_one_folder <- function(caption) {
  chosen_path <- tcltk::tk_choose.dir(
    caption = caption
  ) |>
    normalize_tk_path()

  if (identical(chosen_path, "")) {
    show_error_and_stop("No folder was selected.")
  }

  chosen_path
}

rda_to_object <- function(file_path) {
  temp_env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

  loaded_names <- load(file = file_path, envir = temp_env)

  if (length(loaded_names) == 1) {
    return(get(loaded_names[[1]], envir = temp_env))
  }

  data_frame_names <- loaded_names[
    loaded_names |>
      purrr::map_lgl(\(object_name) {
        get(object_name, envir = temp_env) |>
          inherits("data.frame")
      })
  ]

  if (length(data_frame_names) == 1) {
    return(get(data_frame_names[[1]], envir = temp_env))
  }

  show_error_and_stop(
    paste0(
      "The chosen RDA/RData file contains multiple objects. ",
      "Please make sure that it contains one dataset object only, ",
      "or convert it to a single-object RDS first."
    )
  )
}

save_converted_rds <- function(data_object, source_path, derived_folder) {
  rds_path <- file.path(
    derived_folder,
    paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(source_path)), ".rds")
  )

  saveRDS(data_object, rds_path)

  rds_path
}

load_r_object_file <- function(file_path, invalid_message, derived_folder = NULL) {
  file_ext <- file_path |>
    tools::file_ext() |>
    tolower()

  if (identical(file_ext, "rds")) {
    return(readRDS(file_path))
  }

  if (file_ext %in% c("rda", "rdata")) {
    loaded_object <- rda_to_object(file_path)

    if (!is.null(derived_folder)) {
      save_converted_rds(
        data_object = loaded_object,
        source_path = file_path,
        derived_folder = derived_folder
      )
    }

    return(loaded_object)
  }

  show_error_and_stop(invalid_message)
}

```

```{r choose_paths_and_load_data, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

output_folder <- choose_one_folder(
  caption = "Choose the output folder"
)

derived_folder <- file.path(output_folder, "derived")
dir.create(derived_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

charite_input_path <- choose_one_file(
  caption = "Choose the Charité datasets list file (RDS / RDA / RData)"
)

data_raw_charite <- load_r_object_file(
  file_path = charite_input_path,
  invalid_message = "Please make sure that the chosen file is a RDS / RDA file!",
  derived_folder = derived_folder
)

if (!inherits(data_raw_charite, "data.frame")) {
  show_error_and_stop("The Charité file must contain one data frame / tibble.")
}

dcc_input_type <- tcltk::tk_select.list(
  choices = c(
    "RDS / RDA file",
    "Folder with CSV files"
  ),
  multiple = FALSE,
  title = "Choose the DCC input type"
)

if (identical(dcc_input_type, "")) {
  show_error_and_stop("Please choose how the DCC is stored.")
}

dcc_input_path <- if (identical(dcc_input_type, "Folder with CSV files")) {
  choose_one_folder(
    caption = "Choose the folder that contains the DCC CSV files"
  )
} else {
  choose_one_file(
    caption = "Choose the DCC file (RDS / RDA / RData)"
  )
}

data_raw_dcc <- if (dir.exists(dcc_input_path)) {
  if (!exists("dcc_csv_to_rds", mode = "function")) {
    show_error_and_stop(
      "The folder option was chosen, but dcc_csv_to_rds() is not available yet."
    )
  }

  dcc_result <- dcc_csv_to_rds(dcc_input_path)

  if (is.character(dcc_result) && length(dcc_result) == 1 && file.exists(dcc_result)) {
    readRDS(dcc_result)
  } else {
    dcc_result
  }
} else {
  load_r_object_file(
    file_path = dcc_input_path,
    invalid_message = "Please make sure that the chosen file is a RDS / RDA file or a path for the CSVs file!",
    derived_folder = derived_folder
  )
}

if (!inherits(data_raw_dcc, "data.frame")) {
  show_error_and_stop("The DCC input must contain one data frame / tibble.")
}

```

```{r get_charite_open_datasets, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

default_filter_columns <- intersect(
  c("data_access", "own_or_reuse_data", "open_data_assessment"),
  names(data_raw_charite)
)

selected_filter_columns <- tcltk::tk_select.list(
  choices = names(data_raw_charite),
  preselect = default_filter_columns,
  multiple = TRUE,
  title = "Select the Charité columns that define whether a dataset is open"
)

if (length(selected_filter_columns) == 0) {
  show_error_and_stop(
    "Please select at least one column for the 'open dataset' filter."
  )
}

combination_table <- data_raw_charite |>
  dplyr::count(
    dplyr::across(all_of(selected_filter_columns)),
    name = ".n",
    sort = TRUE
  )

combination_labels <- combination_table |>
  dplyr::select(all_of(selected_filter_columns)) |>
  purrr::pmap_chr(
    \(...) {
      row_values <- list(...)

      value_text <- row_values |>
        purrr::map_chr(\(value) {
          dplyr::coalesce(as.character(value), "<NA>")
        })

      selected_filter_columns |>
        purrr::map2_chr(
          value_text,
          \(column_name, value_name) {
            paste0(column_name, " = ", value_name)
          }
        ) |>
        paste(collapse = "; ")
    }
  )

combination_table <- combination_table |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    .label = paste0("[n = ", .n, "] ", combination_labels)
  )

selected_combination_labels <- tcltk::tk_select.list(
  choices = combination_table$.label,
  multiple = TRUE,
  title = "Select the value-combinations to keep in the Charité data"
)

if (length(selected_combination_labels) == 0) {
  show_error_and_stop(
    "Please select at least one value-combination to keep."
  )
}

selected_combinations <- combination_table |>
  dplyr::filter(.label %in% selected_combination_labels) |>
  dplyr::select(-.n, -.label)

data_raw_charite <- data_raw_charite |>
  dplyr::semi_join(
    selected_combinations,
    by = selected_filter_columns
  )

if (nrow(data_raw_charite) == 0) {
  tcltk::tkmessageBox(
    title = "No rows kept",
    message = "The selected combinations kept 0 rows in the Charité data.",
    icon = "warning",
    type = "ok"
  )
}

```

```{r choose_analysis_columns, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

charite_window <- tktoplevel()
tkwm.title(charite_window, "Choose Charité columns for the analysis")

charite_intro_text <- paste(
  "Choose which columns should be used for each analysis column.",
  sep = "\n"
)

tkgrid(

  pady = 10,
  sticky = "w"
)

charite_doi_var <- tclVar(charite_choices[[1]])

tkgrid(
  ttklabel(charite_window, text = "Column to use as dataset identifier:"),
  ttkcombobox(charite_window, textvariable = charite_dataset_var, values = charite_choices, state = "readonly", width = 30),

tkgrid(
```

```{r rename_and_clean, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

data_raw_charite_renamed <- data_raw_charite |>
  dplyr::rename_with(
    ~ names(charite_column_map),
    .cols = all_of(unname(charite_column_map))
  )

data_raw_dcc_renamed <- data_raw_dcc |>
  dplyr::rename_with(
    ~ names(dcc_column_map),
    .cols = all_of(unname(dcc_column_map))
  )

charite_data_clean_col <- dataset_cleaner(
  input = data_raw_charite_renamed |>
    dplyr::select(dataset),
  dataset_name = "charite_cleaning_steps",
  output_folder = file.path(derived_folder, "charite")
)

dcc_data_clean_col <- dataset_cleaner(
  input = data_raw_dcc_renamed |>
    dplyr::select(dataset),
  dataset_name = "dcc_cleaning_steps",
  output_folder = file.path(derived_folder, "dcc")
)

charite_data_clean <- data_raw_charite_renamed |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    charite_data_clean_col |>
      dplyr::select(dataset, dataset_clean),
    by = "dataset"
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(dataset_clean, .after = dataset)

dcc_data_clean <- data_raw_dcc_renamed |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    dcc_data_clean_col |>
      dplyr::select(dataset, dataset_clean),
    by = "dataset"
  ) |>
  dplyr::relocate(dataset_clean, .after = dataset) |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    doi != dataset_clean,
    doi != dataset
  )

```

Successfully loaded Charité and DCC dataset identifiers lists! Charité has a unique number of **`r charite_data_clean |> dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n_distinct(dataset)) |> dplyr::pull(n)`** datasets, and DCC has a unique number of **`r dcc_data_clean |> dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n_distinct(dataset)) |> dplyr::pull(n)`** datasets.

```{r match_and_clean, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

charite_dcc_joined <- charite_data_clean |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    dcc_data_clean,
    by = "dataset_clean",
    suffix = c("_charite", "_dcc")
  )

charite_dcc_joined_dedup <- charite_dcc_joined |>
  dplyr::distinct()

```

```{r save objects, echo=FALSE}

objects_to_save <- list(
  data_raw_charite = data_raw_charite,
  data_raw_charite_renamed = data_raw_charite_renamed,
  data_raw_dcc = data_raw_dcc,
  data_raw_dcc_renamed = data_raw_dcc_renamed,
  charite_data_clean = charite_data_clean,
  dcc_data_clean = dcc_data_clean,
  charite_dcc_joined = charite_dcc_joined,
  charite_dcc_joined_dedup = charite_dcc_joined_dedup
)

purrr::iwalk(
  objects_to_save,
  \(object, object_name) {
    saveRDS(
      object,
      file = file.path(derived_folder, paste0(object_name, ".rds"))
    )
  }
)

```

```{r count, echo=FALSE}

joined_counts <- tibble::tibble(
  `Number of Charité Articles` =
    charite_dcc_joined_dedup |> dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n_distinct(doi_charite, na.rm = TRUE)) |> dplyr::pull(n),
  `Number of Mentioning Articles` =
    charite_dcc_joined_dedup |> dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n_distinct(doi_dcc, na.rm = TRUE)) |> dplyr::pull(n),
  `Number of Mentioned Datasets` =
    charite_dcc_joined_dedup |> dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n_distinct(dataset_clean, na.rm = TRUE)) |> dplyr::pull(n),
  `Number of Mentions` =
    charite_dcc_joined_dedup |>
      dplyr::distinct(doi_dcc, dataset_clean) |>
      dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n()) |>
      dplyr::pull(n)
)

```
